title: LLMON: An LLM-native Markup Language to Leverage Structure and Semantics at the LLM Interface
abstract: arXiv:2603.22519v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Textual Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a simple and familiar interface: a string of text is used for both input and output. However, the information conveyed to an LLM often has a richer structure and semantics, which is not conveyed in a string. For example, most prompts contain both instructions ("Summarize this paper into a paragraph") and data (the paper to summarize), but these are usually not distinguished when passed to the model. This can lead to model confusion and security risks, such as prompt injection attacks.   This work addresses this shortcoming by introducing an LLM-native mark-up language, LLMON (LLM Object Notation, pronounced "Lemon"), that enables the structure and semantic metadata of the text to be communicated in a natural way to an LLM. This information can then be used during model training, model prompting, and inference implementation, leading to improvements in model accuracy, safety, and security.

translated_title: LLMON：一种在LLM接口层面利用结构与语义的LLM原生标记语言
translated_abstract: 文本大语言模型（LLM）提供了一个简单且为大家熟悉的接口：输入和输出都是一串文本。然而，传递给LLM的信息通常具有更丰富的结构和语义，而这些信息在字符串中并未得到体现。例如，大多数提示词既包含指令（“将这篇论文总结为一段话”），也包含数据（需要总结的论文），但在传递给模型时二者通常不加区分。这可能导致模型混淆以及安全风险，例如提示注入攻击。本工作通过引入一种LLM原生标记语言LLMON（LLM Object Notation，发音为"Lemon"）来解决这一缺陷，该语言能够以自然的方式将文本的结构和语义元数据传达给LLM。这些信息随后可用于模型训练、模型提示和推理实现，从而在模型准确性、安全性和保密性方面带来提升。
tldr: 提出了一种LLM原生标记语言LLMON，能够在LLM接口层面自然地传达文本的结构与语义元数据，从而提升模型的准确性、安全性以及抵抗提示注入攻击的能力。
en_tdlr: LLMON, an LLM-native markup language, naturally conveys the structure and semantic metadata of text at the LLM interface, improving model accuracy, safety, and security against prompt injection attacks.
